note: Generated by scripts/download-assets.mjs. Paths are relative to the page. Overworld sheets: one row of `frames` frames of frameW x frameH in overworldFrames order; walk=false means the standing frames repeat. Entries with `walker` borrow that trainer's overworld sheet (overworld/frame fields copied). source "smogon": github.com/smogon/sprites (`files`, `game`); source "showdown": the Pokémon Showdown trainer sprites (`files` in the pinned mirror, `credit` = the artist); `canonical: false` = community DS-style sprite (fan art); `overworldSource` / `overworldFiles` (/ `overworldCredit`): a community GBA overworld sheet, or (overworldSource "pokeleven") one drawn in this project, `overworldFiles` = the official walker it was edited from; `sources`: every repository (pinned ones with their commit, credit and license; docs/IMAGE_SOURCES.md). Every front is 64x64 (Crystal: 56x56).
